title: Bricks N' Blocks
description: A large array of building blocks!
body:
![DESCRIPTION](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12d466824cc8248641e805e6934f613620568e90.png)

Bricks N' Blocks adds in a variety of bricks, blocks, furniture, and other goodies to assist you in building whatever you can imagine.

Build anything you can think of!

For older versions, please see the curseforge page!

 

All of these blocks are obtainable in Survival. Feel free to leave any suggestions in the comments!

 

 

![BLOCKS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/db48dbb128de05e48f23215c3f4fdb5924711178.png)

This mod adds almost 1700 new blocks!(If not more)

 

Just a few include:

- Dyed Stone + all of its bricks
- Biome Stones + many types and bricks
- Dyed Bricks
- Wooden Floors
- New wood types
- Ores
- Wool stairs/slabs/walls/bricks
- Chairs
- Lamps
- Chandeliers
- Iron/Gold/Diamond/Emerald Stone Bricks + Regular Bricks
-Many, Many More!
 

 

![LAST UPDATE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cee7ec3adda5de1150834a62b4d9e22d73515112.png)

UPDATE 3.2.0:
-Fixed Plants spawning incorrectly

-Fixed Biome stones spawning incorrectly

-Fixed Glass door

-Fixed Plastic/asphalt filters

-Added Plastic filter recipe

-Added Glass Walls

-Added Tinted Glass Slab/stair/trapdoor/door/wall

-Changed Some biome's colors

-Fixed Dragons blood tree generation

-Added Wood buttons, pressure plates

-Added Dragons blood leaves/sapling

Mod Made with MCreator!
